why: Source PDF is scanned (CCITT bilevel images), no text layer.
OCR recovers prose and question structure but corrupts mathematical notation: superscripts lost (x^3 -> x3, R^5 -> R deg), symbols misread (1/p+1/q=1 -> i,1 =1), digits confused (12 -> l2).
Paper and year header pages OCR to garbage, so year attribution is unreliable.
Pages alternate English and Hindi; Hindi pages OCR to noise without a Devanagari model.
extraction_meta.recommendation: Do not import as questions. A Mathematics corpus needs either the born-digital official PDFs or manual transcription of formulas.
